name: Ango
source:
The eldest son of the Mitate family, who is also considered the left hand of the king. A famous martial arts family who has been well known in Migiwa for a long time. Along with his father, he is the strongest warrior of Migiwa. He is a brave and fair person with a lot of hope. He is expected to succeed his family, but his father blames him for not having a spouse after he lost his wife and child at a young age.
His tsukai is a stag.
